teacher: 017's agent (reach_plan_016 with 015's numbers, 016's rollouts and 017's commit rollouts)
student: the rank agent (native rank_game): the same agent with the rank network in place of the rollouts, at the same decisions and over the same candidates

fit.lr_note: Adam, one-cycle schedule peaking at lr

dev_seeds: experiments/020-value-net/seeds.json dev_seeds: compare on the first 100 (part 0), confirm a keeper on the next 100 (part 1); 015's and 017's games there are in 020's dev_baselines.json

step4.variants_note: the last level where the rollouts' own placements are re-ranked by the rank network; above rollout_to_level (28) by the commit model with the preview hidden
step4.blend_note: step 4b: the rollout-ranked pick by the rollouts' mean plus blend[kind] times the network's output; blend_full = the best weights for 8 rollouts on the pilot's checked games (even half scored on the odd half), blend_half = those halved for 017's 16 rollouts (half the rollout noise); to_level 17 = no network inside the rollouts
